title: Nutritious Polish Chickpeas Skillet
description: A hearty and energizing Polish dish featuring chickpeas, perfect for a low-carb diet, this skillet is a fatty and shaggy meal option that will keep you full for hours. It combines the richness of sausage and eggs with the simplicity of chickpeas.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the sliced smoked sausage to cook until browned.
Remove the cooked sausage from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease in the skillet.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the chickpeas to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and grease.
Push the chickpea and onion mixture to one side of the skillet and crack in the eggs, scrambling them until they are cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the chickpea and onion mixture, then add the cooked sausage back into the skillet.
Stir in the shredded cheese until it is melted and well combined with the other ingredients.
Season the skillet with salt, black pepper, and paprika, and serve hot.
